title: Six Memos for the Next Millennium (Lezioni americane)

publication.publisher_or_container: Harvard University Press (Charles Eliot Norton Lectures)
publication.edition: trans. Patrick Creagh; later trans. Geoffrey Brock (2016)

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed the 1985-86 Norton lectures, posthumous 1988 publication, the five completed memos (lightness, quickness, exactitude, visibility, multiplicity), and the explicit distinction between 'a lightness of thoughtfulness' and 'a lightness of frivolity'.

limitations: The lectures were written in Italian and delivered in English; the Creagh translation is the cited edition, and later Brock translation (2016) exists.

copyright.notes: Harvard University Press edition; analytical citation only.
